update.title: Built an evidence pipeline from Work Reports to portfolio pages
update.summary: Preserved screenshots, code, terminal output, comparisons, and data as typed Work Report artifacts, then mapped them into editable blocks for portfolio pages.

preview.description: Diagram showing typed Work Report artifacts mapped to editable Portfolio Editor blocks and rendered on a portfolio page

blocks.body:
## Capture evidence as typed artifacts

Work Report now attaches screenshots, code samples, terminal output, comparisons, and structured data as typed artifacts. Each record identifies the kind of evidence and carries the content needed to use it again.

That turns material produced during daily work into structured input for documentation and portfolio authoring.

## Keep the material with the report

Files are copied into report-owned storage when they are captured, so the report does not depend on the original path remaining available. Text-based artifacts keep both a durable file and inline content: the editor can prefill an editable block while the site can render the same material from a file.

The report therefore preserves both the evidence and enough structure to reuse it.

blocks.body:
## Turn artifact types into editable blocks

Portfolio Editor displays the artifacts attached to a report and maps each type to a matching content block. Dropping a code sample creates a code block; terminal output, comparisons, screenshots, and data receive their corresponding presentation.

The generated block is a starting point that can be moved, labeled, trimmed, or edited alongside the rest of the page.

## Render the same evidence on the portfolio page

Portfolio Site adds renderers for code, terminal sessions, comparisons, and graphs, along with file handling that carries attached material into the project’s media. Once the editor places and adjusts an artifact, the resulting block renders with the same type-specific presentation on the detail page.

Daily work can now move from report evidence to finished portfolio content without being rebuilt by hand.
